name: The Verdant Pursuit Station
introDiscord:
Beyond Recollection Grove, ancient roots close around something that
does not belong in the forest.

Concrete.

Metal.

Dead searchlights.

A pursuit station lies crushed beneath decades of living growth, its
old insignias buried beneath moss while roots twist through shattered
security doors.

Someone has drawn a cheerful mustache on the entrance sign.
introTwitch:

the-verdant-pursuit-station-approach.prompt:
The station's outer corridors have become part forest and part ruin.
Roots punch through observation windows, warning lights blink beneath
moss, and three routes remain barely recognizable.

left.message:
A terminal still displays one surviving filename:

Definitely_Not_Shizuki_whispering-kelp-forest.txt

Opening it reveals a doodle of Shizuki hiding behind an extremely
unconvincing bush while Glimmer floats directly above her.

One Berry is taped underneath.

The note reads:

'They checked this forest SIX TIMES.

At one point I was hiding in their map cabinet.

Excellent professionals.'

right.message:
An old equipment locker has been forced open by tree roots.

Inside are Star Candies beneath a faded label:

PURSUIT SUPPLIES.

Shizuki crossed it out and wrote:

'FOREST DONATION BOX.'

forward.message:
A cracked searchlight flickers awake.

Something in the station answers.

A Verdant Pursuit Grunt steps through the roots, old recovery insignia
still visible beneath the moss.

The forest may have forgotten its orders.

This thing has not.

the-verdant-pursuit-station-depths.prompt:
Deeper inside, broken map tables and tracking equipment remain tangled
beneath thick roots. Old pursuit routes cover the walls, though most now
lead directly into trees.

left.message:
A tracking console activates.

Several old search markers flicker across the map.

Then the nearest Verdant Pursuit Grunt turns directly toward you.

Apparently one piece of equipment still works.

Rude.

right.message:
A damaged medical cabinet is trapped beneath living roots.

Shizuki's newer handwriting crosses over the original facility label:

'Used to hide from them here.

Came back later and stole their medicine.

Much better visit.'
right.fullHpMessage:
The old medical supply remains in the cabinet.

You're already healthy, and the best part of this room is that nobody
gets to tell you whether you can leave.

forward.message:
An old supply crate sits beneath roots that have crushed the facility
seal in half.

Inside are Star Candies.

Shizuki added:

'Roots opened it first.

I am merely participating in forest-approved salvage.'

the-verdant-pursuit-station-threshold.prompt:
The final station wing overlooks Whispering Kelp Forest through cracked
observation glass. Tracking records flicker on dead terminals while
roots grow directly through the old search command insignia.

left.message:
A sealed archive drawer has burst open beneath root pressure.

Among the Star Candies are old pursuit maps.

Every marked search route eventually ends in the same handwritten
annotation:

'STILL MISSED ME.'

right.message:
A Verdant Pursuit Grunt stands beneath an old display:

ESCAPED SUBJECT RECOVERY — ACTIVE

Someone has written underneath:

'Good luck with that.'

The Grunt turns toward you.

Apparently it took the message personally.

forward.message:
A final restorative bottle rests inside Shizuki's old hiding place
behind the archive wall.

Her newer note reads:

'First time I was here, I was hiding.

Second time I came because I wanted to.

Third time I came to put a mustache on the Officer portrait.

Important differences.'
forward.fullHpMessage:
You leave the restorative untouched.

The mustache remains flawless.

boss-antechamber.name: Overgrown Search Command
boss-antechamber.prompt:
The command doors grind open beneath roots thicker than the surrounding
walls.

Old search systems begin waking one screen at a time.

bossPromptDiscord:
Overgrown Search Command flickers back to life.

Maps of Whispering Kelp Forest cover the walls.

Old pursuit routes.

Failed containment sweeps.

Years of searches with no successful recovery.

At the center of the ruined command room, a uniformed figure stands
beneath an institutional rank insignia almost completely covered in
vines.

Shizuki has added a paper mustache to the portrait beside it.

And underneath:

'Came back on my own.

Added mustache.

Left whenever I wanted.'

The Officer turns toward you.

Use /yes to enter Overgrown Search Command or /no to leave Shizuki's
art critique hanging a little longer.

bossRetreatText:
You withdraw into the living roots.

The command doors struggle to close around them and fail.

The forest has been winning this argument for years.

boss.revealText:
The remaining searchlights flare green beneath the overgrowth.

The uniformed figure draws its weapon as an old command flashes across
the surviving terminal:

PURSUIT AUTHORITY RESTORED.

Verdant Pursuit Officer reveals itself!

completionText:
The Verdant Pursuit Officer falls silent.

For a moment, the old station waits for another command.

None comes.

Then the forest answers instead.

Roots tear through the final search displays.

Moss covers the remaining insignia.

The pursuit maps disappear beneath new growth.

One surviving ledger confirms what the forest already knew:

Subject Seven was never recaptured.

Shizuki's newest writing crosses directly over the final record:

'They spent all this time searching the forest for me.

The forest knew exactly where I was.

It just wasn't telling them~

Thanks, forest.'

Beside the note, Glimmer has apparently left one tiny glowing mark.

Beyond the ruined station, the roots open onto a darker current leading
away from the forest.

Far in the distance, something enormous rests beneath the water.

A shape like a rib.

Then another.

And another.

The route toward Leviathan's Wake is open.

Whispering Kelp Forest is complete.
